label: Kodak Ektachrome E100
source: Kodak Alaris technical data E-4000 'KODAK PROFESSIONAL EKTACHROME Film E100' (August 2018, revised 8-18), curves read from the PDF's vector paths (characteristic curves page 3, spectral sensitivity and spectral dye density page 4)

sensitometry.x_unit: log10 exposure H (lux-seconds), absolute, as printed on the chart

spectral_sensitivity.unit: log10 sensitivity (reciprocal of exposure in erg/cm2 required to produce E.N.D. density 1.0)

dye_density.unit: diffuse spectral density; dyes normalized to form a visual neutral density of 1.0 for a 5000 K viewing illuminant

granularity.note: Diffuse rms granularity read at a gross diffuse visual density of 1.0, 48 um aperture (no magnification printed); single published value ('8, extremely fine'), no granularity curve

notes: Approximate digitization; not supplied or endorsed by Kodak Alaris or Eastman Kodak Company. Characteristic curves (page 3): Exposure Daylight 1/100 second, Process E-6, Densitometry Status A; legend B, G, R top-down (B highest D-max). The datasheet gives no Log H Ref, reference exposure or mid-grey point, so log_h_ref is omitted and x stays in absolute log H as printed (axis -3.0 to 1.0). Density includes base and is made monotone non-increasing by running minimum. Spectral sensitivity (page 4): Effective Exposure 1/10 second, Process E-6, Density E.N.D. = 1.0; curves labelled Yellow-, Magenta-, Cyan-Forming Layer are stored as b, g, r. Spectral dye density (page 4): Yellow, Magenta, Cyan and an unlabelled top curve (stored as visual_neutral) published, normalized to form a visual neutral density of 1.0 for a 5000 K viewing illuminant, Process E-6; no D-min or midscale-neutral curve is published. viewing: the datasheet gives no viewing instruction; 5000 K is the viewing illuminant the dye curves are normalized for. balance: daylight or electronic flash (EI 100); photo lamp 3400 K needs WRATTEN 80B (EI 32), tungsten 3200 K needs 80A (EI 25). Not digitized: modulation-transfer curves (page 3). Not published: Print Grain Index, granularity curve.

scan.note: fitted to 93 Lomography community scans (lomography.com/films/871911977-kodak-ektachrome-e100/photos, recent, pages 1-2, 2026-11-11); colours of real scans, not manufacturer data
